cards.name: Daily Security Briefing: Calm Before the Storm
cards.mission_set: Who Killed the Guardians of the Globe?
cards.event_description: Daily Security Briefing: Calm Before the Storm event card
cards.game_effect: Nolan is off. Seems indifferent to the Guardians' deaths. And some of them were his friends. Every instinct I have is screaming this situation isn't right, but I need Nolan operational. If we're facing a new enemy of this scale, we can't afford to have our strongest piece off the board. And if it's not a new enemy…Well, let's just hope I'm wrong. // END BRIEFING // Each character may remove 1 hit from their permanent record.

cards.name: The World Mourns
cards.mission_set: Who Killed the Guardians of the Globe?
cards.game_effect:
Public funeral and global grief. Nolan plays the grieving comrade perfectly—people eat it up. No one suspects. Not yet. Still doesn't explain how someone took out the Guardians and Omni-Man. Darkblood sticking his horns where they don't belong. He'll dig in too far. He always does. May have to deal with him sooner than later.
// END BRIEFING //
WHO KILLED THE GUARDIANS OF THE GLOBE?
Hits with an Energy icon do not count to the Venture Total this battle.

cards.name: Guardians Wiped Out
cards.mission_set: Who Killed the Guardians of the Globe?
cards.game_effect: Situation critical. Full team of The Guardians of the Globe eliminated. Whoever pulled this off either knew their weaknesses... or didn't care. No known assailant but God help us if it's who I suspect. We're blind, exposed, and vulnerable. Need to move fast. No cavalry coming. // END BRIEFING // WHO KILLED THE GUARDIANS OF THE GLOBE? No Teamwork Universe cards may be played this battle.

cards.event_description: We Choose How To Fight event card
cards.game_effect:
They've got the numbers—we don't. A head-on fight is suicide. I read about a Spartan king who held off a hundred thousand with just 300 men. They used the ground. That's what we'll do. Hit first, hit loud—draw a herd in behind us. Let the dead finish the job.

Hits with a Combat icon do not count to the Venture Total this battle.

cards.name: Bleeding Out
cards.mission_set: The Walking Dead: All Out War
cards.game_effect:
Every Savior attack costs us. Even when we win, we lose—good people. Supplies can be replaced. People can't. And we're bleeding out. The Hilltop and Kingdom are cut off. Roads are crawling with threats. We need to regroup, strike hard, and finish this war—before it finishes all of us.

No Ally cards may be played this battle.

cards.name: Half Of Everything
cards.mission_set: The Walking Dead: All Out War
cards.game_effect:
We're scrambling to find enough to satisfy him. Food, ammo—everything's drying up. And "half" doesn't mean anything if he thinks it's not enough. Then someone dies. Can we live like this? If we don't fight back now... are we just waiting for him to kill us anyway?

If cards are drawn from the Draw Pile during this Battle Phase, reduce the number of cards drawn by 1.
